comparisons.reason: The two features measure different constructs. Feature 0 checks whether the OP's post body contains a personal anecdote or first-person experiential narrative. Feature 1 checks whether the OP explicitly acknowledges a counter-argument or a limitation of their own view. The two can occur independently, and the 0/1 rules differ. Both read only the argument column and share the null rule, but a shared source column and null rule do not make the extraction functions equivalent.
